name: elagoht/basicauth
description: A collage plugin that puts HTTP Basic authentication in front of a site: a staging deployment, a preview, a site not launched yet.
setup: Nobody can sign in until there is a user: set `"users"` in this plugin's section of `plugins-config.json` (a password as `sha256:` and its hex, or a bcrypt hash), or `COLLAGE_BASICAUTH_USERS=name:password` in the environment; or `"disabled": true` where the site is open.

config.description: A collage plugin that puts HTTP Basic authentication in front of a site: a staging deployment, a preview, a site not launched yet.

disabled.description: Disabled turns the plugin off, as EnvDisabled does. A disabled plugin needs no users.

protect.description: Protect are the path prefixes that need a sign-in. Default ["/"], everything.

realm.description: Realm is what the browser's sign-in dialog names. Default "Restricted".

skip.description: Skip are path prefixes that never do, even under Protect. Default ["/healthz", "/readyz", "/_collage/"]: a load balancer's health and readiness checks have no password, and neither does collage's development reload stream.

users.description: Users maps a name to a password: in plain text, as "sha256:" and the hex of its SHA-256, or as a bcrypt hash ("$2a$…", "$2b$…", "$2y$…"). A plain password that happens to begin with one of those is written "plain:…". Users from EnvUsers are added to these, and win on a name in both.
